source.title_or_label: Como o MEGADRIVE criava seus GRAFICOS?

technique.name: VDP memory segment discipline
technique.summary: Separate VRAM, CRAM, VSRAM, tile descriptors, DMA and line rendering when planning graphics or validating visual claims.

minimum_required_before_canonical: CRAM/palette snapshot when palette claim exists
DMA budget report for streaming claim
current_gaps: no local runtime evidence in this session

promotion_decision.rationale: The concept reinforces existing VDP budget discipline and supports the new VRAM streaming and scroll FX contracts.

accepted_concepts: VRAM, CRAM, VSRAM, tile descriptors, DMA and line rendering must be planned as separate budgets.
megadrive-vdp-budget-analyst plus vram-streaming-dma-queue own this discipline.
rejected_or_deferred_claims: Source is a direct user summary, not runtime telemetry, so segment-level budget figures are deferred until a fixture confirms them.
No visual or budget status promotion from the summary alone.
required_followups: Produce a VRAM residency fixture and a DMA budget report for streaming claims.
Capture a CRAM/palette snapshot when a palette claim is made.
